categories.main_business_segments: Tianneng Battery Group primarily operates in the battery manufacturing industry, focusing on lead-acid batteries, lithium-ion batteries, hydrogen fuel cells, sodium-ion batteries, and solid-state batteries. The company engages in research, development, production, and sales of high-performance batteries and new energy storage solutions. It also operates in battery materials, energy storage systems, and related services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies including continuous casting and rolling for lead-acid batteries, intelligent manufacturing with automation and digital management systems, and proprietary innovations in materials such as graphene composites and multi-component rare earth alloys. It has developed core technologies in lithium-ion, hydrogen fuel cells, sodium-ion, and solid-state batteries, including energy management systems (EMS) and battery management systems (BMS).
categories.primary_customers_markets: Tianneng serves primarily electric light vehicle manufacturers, energy storage system providers, industrial power users, and communication sectors. Key markets include electric two-wheelers, three-wheelers, micro electric vehicles, and emerging applications like drones and robotics. The company also targets overseas markets, especially in Southeast Asia, Africa, and Europe, with a focus on green transportation and energy storage.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with production bases in Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Anhui, Henan, Guizhou, and Jiangxi provinces. It has expanded overseas with manufacturing and assembly facilities in Vietnam and Singapore, and sales networks covering Southeast Asia, Africa, Europe, and the Americas.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tianneng operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the battery supply chain, focusing on battery manufacturing, assembly, and sales. It also manages upstream procurement of raw materials and components, and integrates supply chain management to optimize production and distribution efficiency.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth with significant R&D investment in advanced battery technologies including lead-acid, lithium-ion, hydrogen fuel cells, sodium-ion, and solid-state batteries. It pursues digital transformation, intelligent manufacturing, and global expansion. Strategic priorities include enhancing energy density, safety, cost reduction, and developing new energy storage and hydrogen fuel cell applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of batteries and related energy storage solutions. The company also earns income from after-sales services, licensing of technology, and sales of recycled materials. It employs a combination of direct sales and distribution channels domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Tianneng is a leading player in China's new energy battery industry, especially dominant in the lead-acid battery market for electric light vehicles. It ranks among the top 10 in China's battery industry and is listed in the Global New Energy Enterprises 500. Competitors include other domestic and international battery manufacturers in lead-acid, lithium-ion, and emerging battery technologies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Tianneng reported revenues of approximately RMB 45 billion, a slight decline from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.55 billion, down 32.5%. Total assets grew 23.6% to RMB 44.3 billion, and net assets increased 3%. The company maintains strong cash flow and continues to invest heavily in R&D, with a 4.16% revenue ratio dedicated to innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tianneng emphasizes its comprehensive technology portfolio spanning multiple battery chemistries, advanced manufacturing capabilities, and a robust nationwide sales and service network. Its products are recognized for high safety, cost-effectiveness, recyclability, and tailored solutions for diverse applications. The company integrates digital and intelligent manufacturing to enhance product quality and customer service, positioning itself as a green energy leader committed to sustainable development.
